Maria Gomez: Planning to flip response-normalizer-v2 flag to 10% at 2026-03-17T22:00Z (10pm UTC). Smoke window 15m, then 50% at 22:30 if healthy. @Liam Chen can you own smoke checks? :rocket:

Liam Chen: I'm available. Will run the smoke checklist and watch token-latency + error-rate dashboards. Share runbook link?

Maria Gomez: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/response-normalizer-v2 — steps + rollback cmds.

Sasha Patel: Quick Q — what's the safe default if something goes wrong (off or v1)?

Maria Gomez: Safe default = v1 (old normalizer). We have automatic fallback to v1 on any 5xx spike >0.5% sustained for 5m. Manual rollback command below.

Maria Gomez: ```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \ 
  https://config.redwood/api/flags/response-normalizer-v2 -d '{"state":"off"}'
```

Ben Roth: I'll monitor ingestion, traces and error budget. I'll trigger rollback if error budget >30% burned in 10m. @deploy-bot please post canary status when live. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary started for response-normalizer-v2 at 2026-03-17T22:00:11Z — 10% traffic. Health: OK (p95 +3ms, errors +0.02%).

Liam Chen: Smoke checks go/green: latency p95 +5ms, errors stable. I ran the quick eval set — no regressions. Proceed to 50% at +30m? :thumbsup:

Maria Gomez: Proceeding to 50% at 2026-03-17T22:30Z. Ben will keep alerts on. If anything odd, abort and rollback to v1. I'll handle comms to Support and Product.

Sasha Patel: One more — do traces/metrics include a rollout tag so I can filter?

Maria Gomez: Yes, telemetry includes rollout_id=rn-v2-2140001234 and flag_variant=v2 in headers/logs.

Ben Roth: Seen the tag in traces. Running a small post-rollout quality check now. Will ping if any anomalies. Thanks all.
